methodology_note: Four distinct evidence types, never collapsed into one score: (1) decoder_cosine = geometric similarity of learned dictionary directions (a diagnostic, not a semantic verdict); (2) activation_pattern_cosine = functional co-activation across Confirmation-subset prompts; (3) top_prompt_jaccard = overlap of each feature's own top-20 firing prompts; (4) interpretation_lexical_jaccard = word overlap between the two features' independent primary-reviewer interpretations (a crude, deterministic proxy for reviewer-judged semantic similarity, not a claim of NLP-level understanding).
